|lore=After the Battle of Yavin, it was politically necessary to demonstrate the unstoppable might of the Empire. The ''Executor'' and Death Squadron ensured this objective.
|game_text=Deploy on your Star Destroyer. It may draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise (two if ''Executor''). Counter Assault is canceled. During your move phase, Landing Claw is canceled here. Once per turn, may take an admiral or a card with “''Executor''” in game text into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
|errata_history={{Card errata/Flagship (V) (Virtual Set 5)}}
|printings={{Card versions/Flagship (Dagobah)}}
|notes=The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Flagship (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Flagship (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The later slip permits the once-per-turn search for an admiral or a card which mentions Executor in game text. The original lists Tactical Recall and Field Promotion separately. The later wording cancels Counter Assault, where the original bars its play. The Star Destroyer deployment, battle destiny and Landing Claw timing remain. 
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards5.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #49 on 14 September 2007); page 4, slip 38. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Flagship]].
